stem: According to the table, which states were the last to ratify, and when?

options.text: Virginia and New York, in the summer of 1788
options.misconception: Virginia and New York were tenth and eleventh, in June and July 1788, not last.
Delaware and Pennsylvania were first and second, not last.
Massachusetts and Maryland were sixth and seventh, in February and April 1788.

options.text: North Carolina in 1789 and Rhode Island in 1790

rationales.D: The last two rows are North Carolina, November 21, 1789, and Rhode Island, May 29, 1790, the twelfth and thirteenth states.
rationales.A: Virginia and New York were tenth and eleventh, in June and July 1788.
rationales.B: Delaware and Pennsylvania were first and second, in December 1787.
rationales.C: Massachusetts and Maryland were sixth and seventh, in February and April 1788.
rationales.general:
1. Read the last two rows of the table.
2. North Carolina ratified on November 21, 1789, as the twelfth state.
3. Rhode Island ratified on May 29, 1790, by 34 to 32.
4. Background: the new government had already begun before either state joined it, with Washington inaugurated in April 1789.
Remember: a last question is answered from the last rows, so read to the bottom.
